description.value: Delany's Coffee House is a family-owned neighbourhood café that has anchored Edgemont Village in North Vancouver since the late 1990s, one of several locations spread across the North Shore. Unlike chain coffee shops, each Delany's has its own distinct decor featuring local photography and art, with both indoor and outdoor seating. The brand maintains an Athlete Ambassadors program, signalling a connection to the active outdoor community that defines the North Shore.
